statistics.pairing: every policy is evaluated on the identical set of scenario snapshots, so all comparisons are within-snapshot
statistics.rationale: the per-snapshot differences are skewed and heavy-tailed, so normal-theory intervals and t-tests would misstate both the interval width and the p-value
